question: What power to shake the triple world arises from contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: One should always contemplate a smoke-colored form
The triple world is named as the object affected
The power to shake it may arise
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world
uncertainties: The smoke-colored object contemplated is not explicitly named in this verse
